Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldBuilder.RuleBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldBuilder.RuleBuilder
Enclosing class:
SldBuilder
public static final class SldBuilder.RuleBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for an SLD <Rule> element.

Obtained via SldBuilder.rule(String) or SldBuilder.rule(). Each rule specifies an optional OgcFilter (or elseFilter()), optional scale denominators, and one or more symbolizers.

Symbolizer methods

Two styles of symbolizer factory exist on this class:

  1. Simple one-liners — return RuleBuilder directly for chaining: point(WellKnownName, String, double), line(String, double), polygon(String, String, double), text(String, String, String, double), raster(double, SldColorMapType, SldColorMapEntry...)
  2. Sub-builder variants — return a specialized builder for full options; call end() to return to this rule: mark(WellKnownName) → SldBuilder.PointBuilder, externalPoint(String, String) → SldBuilder.PointBuilder, stroke(String, double) → SldBuilder.LineBuilder, fill(String) → SldBuilder.PolygonBuilder, label(String) → SldBuilder.TextBuilder, rasterBuilder() → SldBuilder.RasterBuilder

Navigation

From a RuleBuilder you can navigate to:

  • rule() / rule(String) — next rule in same FTS
  • featureTypeStyle() — new FTS block
  • userStyle() — new UserStyle block
  • end() — back to the parent SldBuilder
  • build() — finalize and return StyleContent
